issues.title: Upgrade Java 8 version in CI image and .sdkmanrc
Upgrade Java 17 version in CI image
Replace "via" in documentation and use "over" or "through" instead
Failure analysis of NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException reports "defined in null" when bean definition has no resource description
Headless mode is forced when banner.* file is present.
@DeprecatedConfigurationProperty has no effect when declared on a record component's accessor method
Refine wait period in bomr upgrades to avoid secondary rate limit
Diagnostics are poor when the JMX port used by the Maven start goal is in use
buildSrc's PluginXmlParser will NPE if a parameter has no description
Make tests disabled by @DisabledIfDockerUnavailable more visible in build output
Description of spring-boot-starter-websocket does not make it clear that it's Servlet-specific
Inconsistent discovery of parameter names for selectors in custom actuator endpoints
Allow upgrade candidates to be filtered out when running bomr
Fix Bomr's same minor version upgrade policy to handle Oracle Database's version numbers
SpringBootMockResolver causes AopTestUtils.getUltimateTargetObject to recurse until the stack overflows when it calls it with Spring Security's authentication manager bean
It is not possible to provide a custom TransactionProvider bean for JOOQ
Update getting started documentation to use @SpringBootApplication
NPE in RabbitProperties when user is given, but password not
Homebrew and Scoop should not use repo.spring.io for releases
Upgrade to Gradle Enterprise Gradle Plugin 3.12.1
